Soul Ride Sunday Shop Ride

Prescott, AZ · Downtown · Mountain bike

No-drop

Soul Ride Sunday Shop Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Prescott, AZ. Schedule: Every Sunday (time posted on the shop's social pages), from Soul Ride Bike Shop & Taproom (parking lot behind the shop). About 12–40 miles, a team fast, 25–40 mi; B team moderate no-drop, 12–20 mi.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: a team fast, 25–40 mi; B team moderate no-drop, 12–20 mi. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @soulridemtb the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Soul Ride Sunday Shop Ride group ride

A Sunday mountain bike ride from a downtown Prescott shop with a taproom. Two groups: a fast A team and a moderate, no-drop B team. Riders pedal 3–6 miles to the trailheads and back, then hang out on the patio.
